verses.text: To the choir director. A Psalm of David
How long, O Jehovah? Will You forget me continually? How long will You hide Your face from me?

verses.text: How long will I take counsel in my soul And sorrow in my heart day after day? How long will my enemy be exalted over me?

verses.text: Consider and answer me, O Jehovah my God; Enlighten my eyes lest I sleep the sleep of death,
Lest my enemy say, I have prevailed against him, And my adversaries exult when I am shaken.

tok.t: against him, And my adversaries exult when I am shaken.

verses.text: But I trust in Your lovingkindness; My heart will exult in Your salvation;
I will sing to Jehovah, For He has dealt bountifully with me.
